DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-HITOYOSHI-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-HITOYOSHI-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: お持ちの通知についてですね。どなた宛てで、何を確認したいか伺えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-HITOYOSHI-08-001-SHARED-0.translation: You're asking about your notice, then. Who is it addressed to, and what would you like to check?

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-HITOYOSHI-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-HITOYOSHI-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 私宛ての照会通知です。友人の書類と封筒にまとめてしまい、どれを出せばいいか迷っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-HITOYOSHI-08-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 自分宛ての照会通知だと伝え、友人の書類と混ぜてしまい提出物に迷っていると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-HITOYOSHI-08-001-SHARED-0.translation: It's an inquiry notice addressed to me. I put it in an envelope with my friend's documents, so I'm unsure which documents to submit.
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-HITOYOSHI-08-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that the inquiry notice is yours, but you mixed it with a friend's documents and aren't sure what to submit.

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-HITOYOSHI-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-HITOYOSHI-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: まず、ご本人の名義と対象年を確かめましょう。お友達の書類は、いったん分けてお持ちいただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-HITOYOSHI-08-001-SHARED-0.translation: First, let's check your name and the year concerned. Could you separate your friend's documents for now?

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-HITOYOSHI-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-HITOYOSHI-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 友人の分はこちらに分けます。私の給与の書類は去年の物ですが、通知には別の年が書かれています。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-HITOYOSHI-08-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 友人の書類を分け、自分の給与書類と通知の対象年が違うと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-HITOYOSHI-08-001-SHARED-0.translation: I'll put my friend's documents here. My pay document is from last year, but the notice specifies a different year.
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-HITOYOSHI-08-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Separate your friend's documents and say in Japanese that your pay document and the notice concern different years.

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-HITOYOSHI-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-HITOYOSHI-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 対象年が違うので、そのまま対応するとは判断できません。通知が求める書類を担当者へ確認します。提出期限の欄は読めていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-HITOYOSHI-08-001-SHARED-0.translation: The years differ, so we can't assume this document meets the request. I'll ask the responsible staff what the notice requires. Can you read the submission deadline?

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-HITOYOSHI-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-HITOYOSHI-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 期限の欄は読めますが、必要な年の書類を勤務先から取り寄せると、間に合わないかもしれません。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-HITOYOSHI-08-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 期限欄は読めるが、勤務先から必要年度の書類を取り寄せると間に合わない可能性を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-HITOYOSHI-08-001-SHARED-0.translation: I can read the deadline, but if I request the document for the required year from my employer, it might not arrive in time.
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-HITOYOSHI-08-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you can read the deadline but may miss it while obtaining the correct year's document from your employer.

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-HITOYOSHI-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-HITOYOSHI-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 今の事情も担当者へ伝えます。ここで期限の変更をお約束はできませんが、確認したい内容を一緒にメモしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-HITOYOSHI-08-001-SHARED-0.translation: I'll pass that situation on too. I can't promise a deadline change here, but shall we make a note of your questions together?

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-HITOYOSHI-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-HITOYOSHI-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: お願いします。必要な書類の年と、取り寄せ中の場合の連絡方法を、質問として書いてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-HITOYOSHI-08-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 必要書類の対象年と取り寄せ中の連絡方法を質問メモにするよう頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-HITOYOSHI-08-001-SHARED-0.translation: Please do. Write down questions about which year's document is required and how to contact them while I'm waiting to obtain it.
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-HITOYOSHI-08-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese for a question note covering the required document year and how to contact the office while awaiting it.

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-HITOYOSHI-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-HITOYOSHI-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: その二点を記しました。通知の連絡先へ相談するときに使えます。金額についても質問がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-HITOYOSHI-08-001-SHARED-0.translation: I've written those two points. You can use it when contacting the office listed on the notice. Do you have questions about the amount too?

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-HITOYOSHI-08-001-SHARED-1.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-HITOYOSHI-08-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 金額の判断は今日は求めません。まず通知に書かれた担当へ、対象年と提出の相談をします。原本は持ち帰って保管します。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-HITOYOSHI-08-001-SHARED-1.hintJa: 金額判断は求めず、通知の担当へ対象年と提出を相談し、原本を保管すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-HITOYOSHI-08-001-SHARED-1.translation: I'm not asking for a decision about the amount today. First I'll ask the staff listed on the notice about the year and submission. I'll take the originals home and keep them safe.
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-HITOYOSHI-08-001-SHARED-1.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you aren't asking for an amount decision, will consult the listed staff about the year and submission, and will keep the originals.

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-HITOYOSHI-08-001-SHARED-1.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-HITOYOSHI-08-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 原本と質問のメモをお返しします。担当からの案内も書き留めておくと整理しやすくなります。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-HITOYOSHI-08-001-SHARED-1.translation: Here are your originals and question note. Recording the staff's guidance will help you keep things organized too. Thank you for consulting us.

DLG-SC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 担当表をお渡しします。今日は箱の準備をお願いしたいのですが、説明を始めてもいいですか。
DLG-SC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-001-SHARED-01.translation: Here's your duty roster. I'd like you to prepare boxes today. May I start explaining?

DLG-SC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 収穫をするつもりで来たので、はさみを持っています。箱の準備だけなら、切る道具は使わないのですか。
DLG-SC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 収穫のつもりで持参したはさみと、箱準備の担当を区別して尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-001-SHARED-02.translation: I brought scissors because I thought I'd be harvesting. If I'm only preparing boxes, won't I use cutting tools?
DLG-SC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese about your box-preparation assignment separately from the scissors you brought expecting to harvest.

DLG-SC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今日は収穫は別の班です。あなたには箱の札を整えてもらいます。道具はまだ使わず、どの箱を対象にするか合わせましょう。
DLG-SC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-001-SHARED-03.translation: Another team is harvesting today. You'll arrange the box labels. Don't use any tools yet; let's agree on which boxes are included.

DLG-SC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 同じ色の箱が並んでいて、使った物と未使用の物の見分けがつきません。色ではなく札を読むのですね。
DLG-SC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 箱の色では使用状態を判断できず札で区別すると確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-001-SHARED-04.translation: There are boxes of the same color, and I can't tell used ones from unused ones. We should read their tags rather than judge by color, right?
DLG-SC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm in Japanese that color doesn't identify whether boxes were used, and that you'll distinguish them by their tags.

DLG-SC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。返却の札と、未使用の札を区別します。札が読めない物は推測で加えず、私に尋ねてください。
DLG-SC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes. Distinguish returned tags from unused tags. Don't guess and include boxes with unreadable tags; ask me.

DLG-SC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 未使用の札が付いていても、縁に亀裂がある箱を見つけました。表示を整える対象から外して、場所をお伝えします。
DLG-SC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 未使用札があっても亀裂のある箱を見つけたと報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-001-SHARED-06.translation: I found a box with a crack along its rim even though it has an unused tag. I'll leave it out of the labeling work and tell you where it is.
DLG-SC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Report in Japanese finding a cracked box even though it has an unused tag.

DLG-SC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 亀裂のある箱は私が確認します。今は残りの対象を一緒に見て、使うつもりの箱に混ざらないようにしましょう。
DLG-SC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll check the cracked box. Let's look at the remaining boxes together now so that it doesn't get mixed with the ones we intend to use.

DLG-SC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 札の読めない物と亀裂のある物は、どちらも確認待ちですね。ほかの未使用の箱だけ、お願いされた表示をそろえます。
DLG-SC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 札不明と亀裂の箱を確認待ちとし、対象の箱だけ表示を整えると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-001-SHARED-08.translation: Both the unreadable tags and cracked boxes are awaiting checks, then. I'll arrange the requested labels only on the other unused boxes.
DLG-SC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that unreadable-tag and cracked boxes await checks, and you'll arrange labels only on the intended boxes.

DLG-SC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その範囲でお願いします。終わったら、表示を整えた箱と確認待ちの箱を分けて報告してください。
DLG-SC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please stay within that scope. When finished, report the boxes you've labeled separately from those awaiting checks.

DLG-SC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 未使用の札が読めた箱の表示は整いました。札が読めない箱と亀裂のある箱には、まだ手を付けていません。
DLG-SC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 表示準備済みの箱と、手を付けていない確認待ちの箱を分けて報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've arranged the labels on boxes whose unused tags I could read. I haven't touched the boxes with unreadable tags or cracks yet.
DLG-SC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Report in Japanese which boxes have their labels ready and which unchecked boxes you haven't touched.

DLG-SC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 準備できた範囲が分かりました。確認待ちの分は私が引き継ぎます。今日はここまでで結構です。お疲れさまでした。
DLG-SC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-001-SHARED-11.translation: I understand how much is ready. I'll take over the boxes awaiting checks. That's enough for today. Thank you for your work.

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-02-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-02-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 準備のお手伝いですね。案内板を扱う係の方でしょうか。お持ちの紙を見せていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-02-001-SHARED-.translation: You're helping with preparations, then. Are you handling the signs? Could you show me your paper?

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-02-001-SHARED-.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-02-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 入口に立てる板を運ぶ担当だと聞きました。この図の矢印に沿って持っていけばいいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-02-001-SHARED-.hintJa: 案内板の運搬担当と伝え、持参図の矢印で進んでよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-02-001-SHARED-.translation: I was told to carry the board that will stand at the entrance. Should I carry it along this diagram's arrow?
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-02-001-SHARED-.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you're assigned to carry a sign and ask whether to follow the arrow on your diagram.

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-02-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-02-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: その紙には前回の開催名が入っていますね。今回は受付の配置が変わっているので、先に今日の図へ替えましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-02-001-SHARED-.translation: That paper has the previous event's title. Reception has moved this time, so let's replace it with today's diagram first.

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-02-001-SHARED-.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-02-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 同じ行事だから使えると思っていました。前の入口に人を案内しないよう、古い図は作業用から分けておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-02-001-SHARED-.hintJa: 前回の図を今回用と思った誤りを認め、古い図を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-02-001-SHARED-.translation: I thought it would work because it's the same event. I'll separate the old diagram from the working papers so I don't direct anyone to the previous entrance.
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-02-001-SHARED-.hintTranslation: Acknowledge in Japanese mistaking the old diagram for this event's diagram and separate it.

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-02-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-02-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: こちらが今回の図です。板の運搬係と、来場者をご案内する係は別になっています。今お願いするのは準備だけです。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-02-001-SHARED-.translation: Here's this event's diagram. The sign carriers and visitor guides are separate roles. We're only asking you to help prepare now.

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-02-001-SHARED-.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-02-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: では、板を運び終えても、自分で来場者の通り道を決めたり、矢印の向きを変えたりはしないのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-02-001-SHARED-.hintJa: 準備係と来場者案内係を区別し、経路や矢印を自分で変えないと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-02-001-SHARED-.translation: Then even after carrying the board, I shouldn't decide the visitors' route or change the arrows' direction myself, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-02-001-SHARED-.hintTranslation: Distinguish preparation from visitor guidance in Japanese and confirm you won't change routes or arrows yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-02-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-02-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: はい。設置先は担当と合わせます。荷物を持って移動する前に、通路を使ってよいかも私から確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-02-001-SHARED-.translation: Correct. We'll agree on the installation point with the person responsible. Before you move with it, I'll also check whether the passage can be used.

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-02-001-SHARED-.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-02-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 今は通路の確認待ちなので、この場所で板の名前と担当札を合わせます。移動してよいという返事が来るまでは運び出しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-02-001-SHARED-.hintJa: 移動許可を待つ間、今の場所で板名と担当札を照合すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-02-001-SHARED-.translation: While we're waiting for the passage check, I'll match the board's name with the assignment tag here. I won't carry it out until we're told we may move.
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-02-001-SHARED-.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that while waiting for movement permission, you'll compare the board name and assignment tag where you are.

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-02-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-02-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: その準備をお願いします。図の版と板の名前が合ったら、まだ運搬していないことも次の係へ伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-02-001-SHARED-.translation: Please make that preparation. Once the diagram version and board name match, tell the next person that it hasn't been carried yet too.

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-02-001-SHARED-.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-02-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 今日の図と担当札は合いました。板はまだここにあり、通路の返事を待っていることを引き継ぎます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-02-001-SHARED-.hintJa: 更新図と担当札の照合済み、板は未運搬で通路の返事待ちと引き継ぐ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-02-001-SHARED-.translation: Today's diagram and the assignment tag match. I'll hand over that the board is still here and we're waiting for a reply about the passage.
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-02-001-SHARED-.hintTranslation: Hand over in Japanese that the updated diagram and assignment tag match, the board hasn't moved, and you're awaiting the passage reply.

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-02-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-02-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。その状態で受け取りました。運搬の声かけはこちらからします。ひとまずご案内は以上です。では、また後ほど。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-02-001-SHARED-.translation: Thank you. I've received it in that state. We'll tell you when to carry it. That's all the guidance for now. See you later.

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-03-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-03-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 乗船の控えをお持ちですね。本日は何を確かめたいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-03-001-SHARED-.translation: You have your boarding confirmation, then. What would you like to check today?

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-03-001-SHARED-.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-03-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 大人二人の控えがあります。車で来る予定ですが、この二人分に車も含まれているのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-03-001-SHARED-.hintJa: 大人二人の予約に車の受付も含まれるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-03-001-SHARED-.translation: I have a confirmation for two adults. We plan to come by car. Does this booking for two include the car too?
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-03-001-SHARED-.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether a booking for two adults includes registration of a car.

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-03-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-03-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: この控えでは人数の記載は見えますが、車両の欄は空白です。人数だけで車の受付も済んでいるとは読み取れません。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-03-001-SHARED-.translation: I can see the passenger count on this confirmation, but the vehicle field is blank. The passenger count alone doesn't show that a car has been registered.

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-03-001-SHARED-.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-03-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 車の欄は別なのですね。現地へ車を持ってくる前に、載せられる便かと、追加の申込みが必要かを聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-03-001-SHARED-.hintJa: 車を持参する前に便の条件と追加申込みの要否を照会したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-03-001-SHARED-.translation: So there's a separate vehicle field. Before bringing the car here, I'd like to ask whether the sailing carries cars and whether I need an additional application.
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-03-001-SHARED-.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that before bringing a car, you want to ask about sailing conditions and whether an additional application is needed.

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-03-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-03-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 船の担当窓口へ尋ねる内容をまとめましょう。運航状況も予約とは別に確認が必要です。同行の方とは、車を使う予定を共有されていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-03-001-SHARED-.translation: Let's list your questions for the ferry counter. Operating status must be checked separately from the booking too. Does your companion know you plan to use a car?

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-03-001-SHARED-.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-03-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 同行者は徒歩で乗るつもりだったかもしれません。車を使うかを先に相談して、二人の希望をそろえます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-03-001-SHARED-.hintJa: 同行者と車利用の希望が一致しているかを先に相談すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-03-001-SHARED-.translation: My companion may have intended to board on foot. I'll first discuss whether to use a car so that we agree on what we want.
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-03-001-SHARED-.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you'll first discuss car use with your companion to align your wishes.

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-03-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-03-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: そのうえで、人数・車の有無・希望便を船の相談窓口へ一緒にお伝えください。ここでの照会だけでは、車両の追加や便の変更が完了したことにはなりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-03-001-SHARED-.translation: Then tell the ferry consultation counter the passenger count, whether you'll have a car, and your desired sailing together. This inquiry alone doesn't complete adding a vehicle or changing a sailing.

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-03-001-SHARED-.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-03-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 今の控えはそのままで、車の追加も便の変更もまだなのですね。運航の知らせも、予約内容とは分けて確かめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-03-001-SHARED-.hintJa: 車追加と便変更は未了と確認し、運航状況を予約内容と分けて確かめる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-03-001-SHARED-.translation: So the current confirmation is unchanged, and neither adding a car nor changing the sailing is done yet. I'll also check service notices separately from the booking details.
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-03-001-SHARED-.hintTranslation: Confirm in Japanese that adding a car and changing the sailing are incomplete, and you'll check operations separately from the booking.

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-03-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-03-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: はい。申込み内容と当日の運航は別の確認です。今の控えをお返ししますので、照会したい点を書き添えておきましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-03-001-SHARED-.translation: Yes. Application details and operations on the day are separate checks. I'll return your current confirmation; let's add your inquiry points.

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-03-001-SHARED-.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-03-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 人数は二人、車は相談中、変更手続きは未了とメモしました。同行者の返答を聞いてから、希望をまとめて伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-03-001-SHARED-.hintJa: 人数・車相談中・変更未了をメモし、同行者の返答後に希望を伝えると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-03-001-SHARED-.translation: I've noted two passengers, car use under discussion, and changes not yet processed. Once my companion replies, I'll put our wishes together and tell them.
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-03-001-SHARED-.hintTranslation: Note the passenger count, undecided car use, and incomplete changes in Japanese, and decide to convey your wishes after your companion replies.

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-03-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-03-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: ご相談の内容は整理できました。控えをお忘れなくお持ちください。それでは、よいご旅行を。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-03-001-SHARED-.translation: We've organized your questions. Please remember to take your confirmation. Have a good trip.

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-04-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-04-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: お弁当用の袋をご覧ですか。中に何を入れるご予定でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-04-001-SHARED-.translation: Are you looking at lunch bags? What are you planning to put inside?

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-04-001-SHARED-.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-04-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 弁当箱と水筒を毎日持っていきます。背の高いこちらなら、二つとも入ると思ったのですが。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-04-001-SHARED-.hintJa: 弁当箱と水筒を入れる用途を伝え、高い袋を候補にした理由を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-04-001-SHARED-.translation: I take a lunch box and water bottle every day. I thought this tall one might hold both.
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-04-001-SHARED-.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that it's for a lunch box and bottle and why you considered the taller bag.

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-04-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-04-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 高さのほかに、底の幅や中での置き方も関わります。お使いの弁当箱の寸法は分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-04-001-SHARED-.translation: Besides height, the base width and how you arrange things inside matter too. Do you know your lunch box's dimensions?

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-04-001-SHARED-.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-04-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 高さは低い箱ですが、底の幅は測っていません。袋が高いだけでは、底が合うか分からないのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-04-001-SHARED-.hintJa: 弁当箱の底幅は未測定で、高さだけでは適合しないと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-04-001-SHARED-.translation: It's a shallow box, but I haven't measured the base width. A tall bag alone doesn't tell us whether the base fits, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-04-001-SHARED-.hintTranslation: Confirm in Japanese that you haven't measured the box's base width and height alone doesn't establish a fit.

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-04-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-04-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: はい。こちらの表示には外側の寸法が書かれています。入れられる範囲と同じとは限らないので、そのまま弁当箱の幅と同一にはできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-04-001-SHARED-.translation: That's right. This label gives external dimensions. They aren't necessarily the usable space, so you can't directly equate them with your box's width.

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-04-001-SHARED-.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-04-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 外の寸法と内側の広さも分けて比べたいです。水筒を横へ置くと弁当が傾くので、二つの置き方も考えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-04-001-SHARED-.hintJa: 外寸と内側の広さを区別し、弁当箱と水筒の置き方も考えると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-04-001-SHARED-.translation: I'd like to compare the outside dimensions and inside space separately too. Putting the bottle sideways tilts my lunch box, so I'll think about arranging both items.
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-04-001-SHARED-.hintTranslation: Distinguish outside dimensions from inside space in Japanese and say you'll consider how to arrange the lunch box and bottle.

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-04-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-04-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: ご自宅の物をどう入れるかが分かれば候補を絞れます。手入れも気になるようでしたら、こちらの取扱表示を見ましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-04-001-SHARED-.translation: Knowing how your own things will fit can narrow the choices. If care matters too, let's check this care label.

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-04-001-SHARED-.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-04-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 洗いやすさを優先したいのですが、こちらは手洗いの表示ですね。家の洗濯機で洗えると決めつけず、表示も控えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-04-001-SHARED-.hintJa: 手洗い表示を読み、洗濯機対応を推測せず取扱条件を控える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-04-001-SHARED-.translation: I'd like easy cleaning, but this label says hand-wash. I won't assume it's machine-washable at home; I'll note the instructions too.
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-04-001-SHARED-.hintTranslation: Read the hand-wash label in Japanese and note the care conditions without assuming machine washing is allowed.

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-04-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-04-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 今分かったのは袋の表示です。弁当箱と水筒が収まるかはまだなので、寸法を測ってから決めてもよろしいと思います。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-04-001-SHARED-.translation: What we've established is the bag's labeling. We still don't know whether your box and bottle fit, so you could measure them before deciding.

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-04-001-SHARED-.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-04-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 今日は買わず、底の幅と水筒の大きさを測ります。候補の袋の表示をメモできたので、それと比べてから選びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-04-001-SHARED-.hintJa: 購入を保留し、家の物の寸法を測って候補の表示と比較すると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-04-001-SHARED-.translation: I won't buy today. I'll measure the base width and bottle size. I've noted the candidate bag's label, so I'll compare those before choosing.
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-04-001-SHARED-.hintTranslation: Put off buying in Japanese and decide to measure your belongings and compare them with the candidate bag's label.

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-04-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-04-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: メモはお持ち帰りください。寸法が分かりましたら、またご一緒に比べましょう。ありがとうございました。またお越しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-04-001-SHARED-.translation: Please take your note home. Once you have the dimensions, let's compare them together again. Thank you. Please visit again.

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-05-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-05-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 交代の方ですね。ラインには停止中の札が出ています。先に引継ぎの内容をお話しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-05-001-SHARED-.translation: You're taking over the shift, then. The line has a “Stopped” tag. I'll explain the handover first.

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-05-001-SHARED-.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-05-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 札を見ました。止まっている間に部品を取り出す担当なのかと思いましたが、私が触ってよい範囲はどこですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-05-001-SHARED-.hintJa: 停止札だけでは判断せず、部品取出しを含め触れてよい担当範囲を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-05-001-SHARED-.translation: I saw the tag. I thought I might be assigned to remove parts while it's stopped, but what am I allowed to touch?
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-05-001-SHARED-.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese about your permitted work scope, including removing parts, without judging from the stopped tag alone.

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-05-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-05-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 今お願いするのは、手元の部品票の照合です。停止の札だけで機械に触れてよいとは判断しないでください。設備の確認は担当が行っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-05-001-SHARED-.translation: Right now, we're asking you to compare the parts slips in front of you. Don't take the stopped tag alone as permission to touch the machine. The equipment staff are checking it.

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-05-001-SHARED-.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-05-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: では機械の操作はせず、部品票を見ます。こちらの箱は検査済みの札と、検査待ちの票が重なっています。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-05-001-SHARED-.hintJa: 機械は操作しないと述べ、同じ箱の検査済みと検査待ちの表示の重なりを報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-05-001-SHARED-.translation: Then I won't operate the machine; I'll look at the slips. This box has an inspected tag overlapped by an awaiting-inspection slip.
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-05-001-SHARED-.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you won't operate the machine and report overlapping inspected and awaiting-inspection labels on one box.

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-05-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-05-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 同じ箱に違う状態の表示があるのですね。どちらが正しいかを今ここで推測せず、部品番号も残して検査担当へ伝えましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-05-001-SHARED-.translation: The same box has conflicting status labels, then. Let's not guess which is right here; keep the part number too and tell the inspection staff.

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-05-001-SHARED-.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-05-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 番号はこの票で読めましたが、検査の結果は見つかりません。箱を次の工程へ渡す前に、表示が食い違っていると報告します。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-05-001-SHARED-.hintJa: 読めた部品番号と見つからない検査結果を区別し、次工程へ渡す前に報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-05-001-SHARED-.translation: I could read the number on this slip, but I can't find the inspection result. Before passing the box to the next process, I'll report the conflicting labels.
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-05-001-SHARED-.hintTranslation: Distinguish the readable part number from the missing inspection result in Japanese and report before passing the box to the next process.

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-05-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-05-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: その箱は確認待ちとして担当へ引き継ぎます。あなたは票の情報をまとめてください。機械の再開についての指示は、まだ出していません。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-05-001-SHARED-.translation: We'll hand that box to the responsible staff as awaiting confirmation. Please compile the slip information. No instruction to restart the machine has been given yet.

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-05-001-SHARED-.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-05-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 部品の表示を確認する話と、機械を再開する話は別ですね。箱の結果が分かっても、自分の判断で始動しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-05-001-SHARED-.hintJa: 部品の確認と機械再開を別にし、自分で始動しないと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-05-001-SHARED-.translation: Checking the parts labels and restarting the machine are separate matters, then. Even if we learn the box's result, I won't start it on my own judgment.
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-05-001-SHARED-.hintTranslation: Confirm in Japanese that checking parts and restarting the machine are separate and you won't start it yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-05-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-05-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: はい。部品番号、重なっていた二つの表示、結果票が見当たらないことを、引継ぎメモで確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-05-001-SHARED-.translation: Correct. Let's check the handover note for the part number, the two overlapping labels, and the missing result slip.

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-05-001-SHARED-.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-05-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 三点ともメモに残しました。機械には触れず、食い違いのある箱を確認待ちとして引き継いだ、と次の方にも伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-05-001-SHARED-.hintJa: 番号・二表示・結果未受領を記録し、機械未操作と箱確認待ちを引き継ぐ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-05-001-SHARED-.translation: I've recorded all three points. I'll also tell the next person I didn't touch the machine and handed over the conflicting-label box as awaiting confirmation.
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-05-001-SHARED-.hintTranslation: Record the number, both labels, and missing result in Japanese, and hand over that the machine wasn't operated and the box awaits confirmation.

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-05-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-05-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 照合の担当分は受け取りました。再開の連絡は担当から行いますので、今の引継ぎはここまでです。どうもご苦労さまでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-05-001-SHARED-.translation: I've received your comparison work. The responsible staff will contact you about restarting, so that's the end of this handover. Thank you for your work.

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-06-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-06-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 今日の記録表を受け取ります。区画名と測定した時点が分かるようになっていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-06-001-SHARED-.translation: I'll take today's record sheet. Does it show the plot names and when measurements were taken?

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-06-001-SHARED-.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-06-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 実は、昨日の紙を見ながら今日の欄へ同じ数字を書いてしまいました。今日はまだ水位を確かめていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-06-001-SHARED-.hintJa: 昨日の数字を今日の欄へ写し、今日の水位は未確認と申し出る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-06-001-SHARED-.translation: Actually, I copied yesterday's figures into today's fields while looking at yesterday's sheet. I haven't checked today's water levels yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-06-001-SHARED-.hintTranslation: Admit in Japanese copying yesterday's figures into today's fields and not checking today's water levels yet.

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-06-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-06-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 申し出てくれてよかったです。その数字を今日の測定結果にはしません。どの区画の欄へ写したか、先に合わせましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-06-001-SHARED-.translation: I'm glad you told me. We won't treat those figures as today's measurements. First let's identify which plots' fields you copied into.

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-06-001-SHARED-.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-06-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 区画名が似ていたので、隣の区画の値まで写したかもしれません。読める名前と、まだ自信のない欄を分けてお伝えします。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-06-001-SHARED-.hintJa: 似た区画名を取り違えた可能性と、自信のある欄・ない欄を区別して伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-06-001-SHARED-.translation: The plot names were similar, so I might even have copied the neighboring plot's value. I'll distinguish the names I can read from fields I'm still unsure about.
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-06-001-SHARED-.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you may have confused similar plot names, distinguishing fields you're sure of from those you aren't.

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-06-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-06-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 記録の対象を一緒に確かめましょう。昨日の原紙は残し、今日の実測値がない欄は未測定と分かる形に整理します。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-06-001-SHARED-.translation: Let's identify the records' subjects together. We'll keep yesterday's original sheet and mark fields without today's actual readings as unmeasured.

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-06-001-SHARED-.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-06-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 元の紙はそのままお渡しします。今日の空欄を埋めるために、私が水を増やしたり減らしたりする話ではないのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-06-001-SHARED-.hintJa: 原紙を渡し、記録の訂正と水の増減は別だと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-06-001-SHARED-.translation: I'll hand you the original sheet unchanged. This doesn't mean I should add or remove water to fill today's blank fields, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-06-001-SHARED-.hintTranslation: Hand over the original in Japanese and confirm that correcting records and adjusting water are separate.

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-06-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-06-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: はい。記録の訂正と、水の調整は別です。今日どこを誰が測るかも、これから私が担当を合わせます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-06-001-SHARED-.translation: Correct. Correcting records and adjusting water are separate. I'll now coordinate who measures which plots today too.

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-06-001-SHARED-.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-06-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 私は測る係としてまだ説明を受けていないので、田へ入って測り直すことも控えます。今は表の区画名の照合をします。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-06-001-SHARED-.hintJa: 測定の説明を未受講と伝え、田へ入らず区画名の照合を担当すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-06-001-SHARED-.translation: I haven't been instructed as a measurer yet, so I won't enter the paddy to measure again either. I'll compare the plot names on the sheet now.
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-06-001-SHARED-.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you haven't received measurement instructions and will compare plot names without entering the paddy.

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-06-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-06-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: お願いします。数値がないことを消さずに残せば、次の担当が今日の確認が必要だと分かります。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-06-001-SHARED-.translation: Please do. Leaving the lack of readings visible will tell the next person that today's checks are needed.

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-06-001-SHARED-.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-06-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 昨日の値を写した箇所が分かるように整理できました。今日の結果は未測定とし、原紙と一緒に担当の確認へ戻します。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-06-001-SHARED-.hintJa: 転記箇所と今日の未測定を明記し、原紙と一緒に担当へ戻す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-06-001-SHARED-.translation: I've arranged it so the places copied from yesterday are clear. I'll mark today's results unmeasured and return the sheet with the original for the responsible staff to check.
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-06-001-SHARED-.hintTranslation: Clearly mark copied entries and today's unmeasured status in Japanese and return them with the original to the responsible staff.

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-06-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-06-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 記録の経緯まで受け取りました。測定の担当はこちらで整えます。今回の打合せはこれで終わりにしましょう。お先にどうぞ。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-06-001-SHARED-.translation: I've received the history of the records too. I'll organize the measuring assignments. Let's finish this meeting here. Please go ahead.

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-07-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-07-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 今日の担当は資材の受入れです。置場の図を渡すので、搬入前に気になる点を聞かせてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-07-001-SHARED-.translation: Today's assignment is receiving materials. Here's the storage-area diagram. Before delivery, tell me any concerns.

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-07-001-SHARED-.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-07-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 図の置場まで来る途中、人がそこを通っていました。今も通り道に見えるのですが、この場所に資材を並べてよいのですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-07-001-SHARED-.hintJa: 図の資材置場を人が通っていたと伝え、置いてよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-07-001-SHARED-.translation: On my way to the storage spot on the diagram, I saw people passing through it. It still looks like a walkway. May we place materials there?
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-07-001-SHARED-.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that people were walking through the diagram's materials area and ask whether materials may be placed there.

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-07-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-07-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 通っていた位置を図で教えてください。置場と歩行者の経路が重なっていないか、今の状態を合わせます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-07-001-SHARED-.translation: Show me on the diagram where they passed. We'll compare the current situation to see whether the storage area overlaps the pedestrian route.

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-07-001-SHARED-.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-07-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: この角から置場を横切っていました。図には柵が続いていますが、現場では切れて見えた部分があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-07-001-SHARED-.hintJa: 目撃した経路と、図では続く柵が現場で切れて見えた位置を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-07-001-SHARED-.translation: They crossed the storage area from this corner. The diagram shows a continuous fence, but part of it looked interrupted on site.
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-07-001-SHARED-.hintTranslation: Indicate in Japanese the route you saw and where the fence looked interrupted although it is continuous on the diagram.

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-07-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-07-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: その相違はこちらで確認します。あなたが柵をつなぎ直したり、別の場所へ置場を移したりせず、搬入の調整を待ってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-07-001-SHARED-.translation: We'll check that discrepancy. Don't reconnect the fence or move the storage area elsewhere yourself; wait for delivery coordination.

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-07-001-SHARED-.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-07-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 柵や置場を私の判断で変える仕事ではないのですね。資材を持って来る人にも、今は運び込まず担当の返事を待つと伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-07-001-SHARED-.hintJa: 柵や置場を自分で変えないと確認し、運搬を待ってもらう意向を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-07-001-SHARED-.translation: So changing the fence or storage area isn't for me to decide. I'll tell the people bringing materials not to bring them in yet and to await the responsible staff's reply.
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-07-001-SHARED-.hintTranslation: Confirm in Japanese that you won't change the fence or storage area yourself and say you intend to have transport wait.

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-07-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-07-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 搬入側への連絡はこちらから行います。あなたは、見えた位置と状態のメモを私へ渡してください。通路へ戻って調べる必要はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-07-001-SHARED-.translation: We'll contact the delivery side ourselves. Please give me a note of the locations and conditions you saw. You don't need to return to the passage to investigate.

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-07-001-SHARED-.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-07-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 通った人の数や目的までは分からないので、それは書きません。見えた通り道と柵の切れ目の位置だけ、図に添えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-07-001-SHARED-.hintJa: 人数や目的は不明とし、見えた経路と柵の位置だけをメモに残す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-07-001-SHARED-.translation: I don't know the number of people or their purpose, so I won't write that. I'll add only the route I saw and the fence-gap location to the diagram.
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-07-001-SHARED-.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that the number and purpose are unknown and note only the observed route and fence location.

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-07-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-07-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: メモを受け取りました。搬入側には保留を伝えています。置場を使える状態にしたという連絡ではないので、作業開始は改めてお知らせします。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-07-001-SHARED-.translation: I've received your note. I've told delivery to hold off. That doesn't mean the area is ready for use; we'll contact you separately about starting work.

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-07-001-SHARED-.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-07-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 受入れ担当でも、まだ資材は並べません。図との相違を報告済みで、搬入と開始の連絡を待っていると引き継ぎます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-07-001-SHARED-.hintJa: 報告済みでも資材配置は未開始とし、搬入調整と開始連絡待ちを引き継ぐ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-07-001-SHARED-.translation: Even though I'm receiving materials, I won't arrange them yet. I'll hand over that the diagram discrepancy was reported and we're awaiting delivery and start instructions.
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-07-001-SHARED-.hintTranslation: Hand over in Japanese that the report is complete but material placement hasn't started, and delivery coordination and start instructions are pending.

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-07-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-07-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: はい、その区別でお願いします。私からの返事まで担当作業は保留です。今朝の説明はここで終えます。それでは、いったんお戻りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-07-001-SHARED-.translation: Yes, please keep that distinction. Your assigned work is on hold until I reply. That's all for this morning's explanation. Please go back for now.

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-08-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-08-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: カードをお持ちですね。先ほどの紛失のご相談に関するご用件でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-08-001-SHARED-.translation: You have a card with you. Is this about your earlier lost-card consultation?

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-08-001-SHARED-.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-08-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 電話したあとでカードが一枚見つかりました。なくしたと思ったのは間違いかもしれないので、さっきの相談を取り消したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-08-001-SHARED-.hintJa: 電話相談後にカードを一枚見つけたため紛失相談の取消しを希望すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-08-001-SHARED-.translation: I found one card after calling. I may have been mistaken about losing it, so I'd like to cancel the earlier consultation.
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-08-001-SHARED-.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you found a card after the call and want to cancel the lost-card consultation.

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-08-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-08-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 見つかったカードと、紛失したとしてお伝えになった口座が同じかを先に確かめましょう。暗証番号は口にしないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-08-001-SHARED-.translation: Let's first check whether the card you found belongs to the account you reported lost. Please don't say your PIN aloud.

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-08-001-SHARED-.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-08-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 通帳と照らすと、これは自分の別口座のカードでした。電話で伝えた口座のカードは、まだ見つかっていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-08-001-SHARED-.hintJa: 見つけたのは自分の別口座のカードで、紛失対象は未発見と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-08-001-SHARED-.translation: Comparing it with my passbook, this is my card for a different account. I still haven't found the card for the account I mentioned on the phone.
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-08-001-SHARED-.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that the found card is yours for another account and the reported lost card is still missing.

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-08-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-08-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: それなら、見つかった一枚と紛失の対象を分けて伺います。電話でどこまで受付が済んだかは確認しますので、今は完了と推測しないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-08-001-SHARED-.translation: Then we'll distinguish the found card from the lost one. We'll check how far the phone request was processed, so don't assume it's complete for now.

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-08-001-SHARED-.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-08-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 電話では紛失を伝えたところまで覚えていますが、停止完了の返事を聞き取れませんでした。受付の状態を確認してもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-08-001-SHARED-.hintJa: 電話で停止完了の返事を聞き取れず、現在の受付状態を確認してほしいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-08-001-SHARED-.translation: I remember reporting the loss on the phone, but I couldn't understand the reply about whether suspension was complete. Could you check the current processing status?
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-08-001-SHARED-.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you couldn't understand the telephone reply about completed suspension and ask for the current request status.

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-08-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-08-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 担当への照会で、対象カードの利用停止の受付は確認できました。再発行の申込みはまだなので、ご希望を伺ってからそちらの案内につなぎます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-08-001-SHARED-.translation: After checking with the responsible staff, we've confirmed acceptance of the request to suspend the affected card. Replacement hasn't been requested yet, so we'll ask your wishes before referring you for that guidance.

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-08-001-SHARED-.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-08-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 停止の受付と再発行は別なのですね。なくしたほうの再発行について、費用や受取方法を聞いてから申し込みたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-08-001-SHARED-.hintJa: 停止受付と再発行を区別し、費用と受取方法を聞いてから申込みたいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-08-001-SHARED-.translation: Acceptance of suspension and replacement are separate, then. I'd like to hear the cost and collection methods for replacing the lost card before applying.
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-08-001-SHARED-.hintTranslation: Distinguish suspension acceptance from replacement in Japanese and say you want to hear costs and collection methods before applying.

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-08-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-08-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: その希望を担当へ伝えます。今見つかった別口座のカードまで、今回の紛失対象として書き加えることはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-08-001-SHARED-.translation: I'll pass that wish to the staff. We won't add the newly found card for your other account as another card lost in this case.

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-08-001-SHARED-.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-08-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 見つかった別のカードは自分で保管します。なくしたカードは未発見、停止の受付は確認済み、再発行は相談前と整理できました。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-08-001-SHARED-.hintJa: 別カードは保管、紛失対象は未発見、停止受付済み、再発行相談前と整理する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-08-001-SHARED-.translation: I'll keep the other card I found. So the lost card is still missing, suspension request acceptance is confirmed, and replacement hasn't been discussed yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-08-001-SHARED-.hintTranslation: Summarize in Japanese that you'll keep the other card, the lost card is missing, suspension acceptance is confirmed, and replacement consultation is pending.

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-08-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-08-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: ご申告の違いは整理できました。再発行のご案内は担当へおつなぎします。お持ちの通帳も忘れずに。私からはこれで失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-YATSUSHIRO-08-001-SHARED-.translation: We've clarified the difference in your report. I'll connect you to the staff for replacement guidance. Don't forget your passbook. That concludes my part.

DLG-SC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 見学の案内は、どんな所を中心にご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-001-SHARED-01.translation: Which parts would you most like the tour to focus on?

DLG-SC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 石垣に興味があります。次の予定まで三十分なので、建物を全部回るより、石垣を見ながら短く説明を聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 三十分の余裕で全建物より石垣中心の短い案内を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'm interested in the stone walls. I have thirty minutes until my next appointment, so I'd prefer a short explanation by the walls to touring every building.
DLG-SC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Request in Japanese a short stone-wall-focused tour rather than every building, with thirty minutes available.

DLG-SC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらの門の近くなら、短い案内をご用意できます。歩く距離も長くありません。
DLG-SC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-001-SHARED-03.translation: We can give you a short tour near this gate. It doesn't involve much walking either.

DLG-SC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: その案内をお願いします。石の大きさだけでなく、積み方をどこから見るか知りたいです。
DLG-SC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 門近くの案内を選び石の大きさに加え積み方の見方を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'd like that tour. Besides the stones' sizes, I'd like to know where to look to understand how they're stacked.
DLG-SC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Choose the tour near the gate in Japanese and ask how to view the stacking as well as stone size.

DLG-SC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 少し離れた位置から全体を見た後、角の部分をご案内します。
DLG-SC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-001-SHARED-05.translation: We'll look at the whole wall from a little distance first, then show you the corner.

DLG-SC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 最初は全体ですね。門の横の石だけに近づいて見るより、こちらから形を確かめます。
DLG-SC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 全体観察を先に行い単石へ接近するより離れた形を確かめる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-001-SHARED-06.translation: The whole wall first, then. I'll check its shape from here rather than just going close to the stones beside the gate.
DLG-SC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you'll view the whole shape from a distance first instead of approaching individual stones.

DLG-SC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 角をご覧になると、石同士がどう接しているかも見えます。
DLG-SC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-001-SHARED-07.translation: At the corner, you can also see how the stones meet each other.

DLG-SC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 見えました。写真では一つずつの石に目が行きましたが、今日は組み合わせの形を見られました。
DLG-SC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 角の接合を見て写真の単石より組合せを理解したと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-001-SHARED-08.translation: I see it. In photographs I focused on individual stones, but today I could see the shape they form together.
DLG-SC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that seeing the corner joints helped you understand the combined form rather than the individual stones in photos.

DLG-SC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 案内はここまでです。ご出発まで少し余裕がありますね。
DLG-SC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-001-SHARED-09.translation: That's the end of the tour. You still have a little time before leaving.

DLG-SC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 残りの時間は今の位置からもう一度眺めます。短い案内でも知りたかった積み方を聞けたので、次の予定へ行けます。
DLG-SC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 残時間に現位置から再観察し知りたい積み方を聞け次予定へ行けると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll spend the remaining time looking again from here. Even with a short tour, I learned about the stacking I wanted to understand, so I can head to my next appointment.
DLG-SC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you'll look again from your current position and can go to your next appointment after learning about the stacking.

DLG-SC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご希望の所をご覧いただけてよかったです。それでは、次のお出かけもお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'm glad you could see what interested you. Enjoy your next outing too.
